svg.title: Two independent tracks, one balanced assessment
svg.desc: Known vehicle travel in two Run records raises a user-trust question. Three tunnel walks provide a positive resilience result. Neither track establishes root cause or population-wide behavior.

g.text: MAPMYRUN / FIELD EVIDENCE
Two independent tracks. One balanced assessment.
Different methods and conclusions; no causal link between the tracks was established.
WORKOUT INTEGRITY / OPEN QUESTION
GPS / DEVICE RESILIENCE / POSITIVE RESULT
Known driving entered Run records
Three plausible saved tunnel walks
Two active sessions included vehicle travel;
one recorded a physically implausible 2:02 mile.
The unended-session behavior may be intentional.
Could users better recognize or repair the result?
Six tunnel passages across three phone / Watch
conditions; all workouts saved and stayed plausible.
Positive evidence under the tested conditions.
No reference measurement of GPS accuracy.
Root cause, prevalence, and severity remain unknown.
One walk per condition; endpoints were not exact.
NEXT DECISION
Establish context and impact, examine recovery, then compare product choices and their tradeoffs.
Reported observations from the prior assessments; illustrative summary, not original test evidence.
Michael D. Jensen
